hermes.scope: Unmodified official functions, isolated home, network disabled during admission. Not the full Hermes CLI, Desktop, installation lifecycle or model agent loop.

live_connection.initial_harness_correction: get_record defaults to Markdown; the successful structured-read check explicitly requested format=json. Failed harness evidence is retained privately.

saved_resource_use.scope: Actual pinned caption Python code run by Main; no rendered-media assessment or full Hermes agent run.

spend.agent_provider_usage: Existing agent provider costs apply when an operator uses the plugin.

activation.optional_project_rule: Copyable operator-selected instructions in README; no automatic project-file edits.
activation.automatic_selection_tested: Controlled natural task under explicit project opt-in; no default or unaided selection claim.

actual_client_trial.release_1_0_1_changes: Documentation, verification and worked-example additions; same MCP and skill runtime bytes.

measurements_including_diagnostics.usage_scope: Maximum cumulative usage per unique native thread, including both preliminary trials and the clean retest. Cache-read input is a subset of inputTokens. Subscription usage, not an invoice.

actual_client_trial.instrumentation: Official unmodified Hermes CLI and plugin loader; native Codex runtime with process-only isolation settings and a transparent, bounded localhost MCP recorder forwarding actual Veyrul responses. Existing client sign-in; no copied credential or global config edit.
actual_client_trial.preliminary_runs: Two pre-model CLI launch errors and a numerically successful preliminary use/return pair retained. The latter read unrelated global workstation instructions, so a fresh isolated pair supplies the final evidence.
actual_client_trial.skill_loader_limit: The native Codex callback requested approval for skill_view under unattended policy. The agent recovered through the five read-only Veyrul tools. This is not proof of universal skill-loader compatibility.
not_established: Default or unaided selection without opt-in
